## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Orexin discoverers awarded Lasker Award](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/09/biotech-news-orexin-discovers-awawrded-prestigious-lasker-award/)** — *STAT*
  * The discoverers of the orexin neuropeptide system were honored with the Lasker Award for uncovering key central mechanisms governing sleep and wakefulness, paving the way for targeted narcolepsy and insomnia therapies.

* **[Recombinant shingles vaccine associated with lower long-term dementia risk](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/more-impossible-ignore-vaccine-effects)** — *Science*
  * Multi-cohort observational data demonstrate a consistent reduction in post-vaccination dementia incidence following administration of Shingrix.
  * Researchers hypothesize that suppressing persistent latent herpes zoster virus reduces chronic central neuroinflammation contributing to neurodegeneration.

* **[Industry framework proposed for extrahepatic oligonucleotide delivery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00125-2)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*
  * Authors outline a quality control framework designed to eliminate methodological artifacts in preclinical oligonucleotide research.
  * The guidelines aim to improve translational fidelity and commercial viability when targeting tissues beyond the liver.

* **[Selective cysteine restriction extends healthspan independently of methionine](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.04.749519)** — *bioRxiv*
  * In *C. elegans* and *Cth*-deficient mice, selective reduction of dietary cysteine (without methionine restriction) enhanced stress survival, immunometabolic fitness, and lifespan.
  * Results challenge standard methionine-restriction models, identifying cysteine regulation as the primary driver of sulfur amino acid longevity pathways.

* **[Frozen section foundation model advances intraoperative digital pathology](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04703-0)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A vision foundation model (CRISP) trained exclusively on intraoperative frozen section slides demonstrated superior diagnostic accuracy across surgical workflows compared to existing multimodal models.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Tyra Biosciences shares dip as dabogratinib misses internal Phase 2 target](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/tyra-bladder-cancer-dabogratinib-study-results/829917/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Daily oral FGFR3 inhibitor dabogratinib produced a 57% 3-month complete response rate in non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), falling below the ~70% benchmark targeted by investors.
  * Tyra is positioning the oral therapeutic as a non-invasive alternative to catheter-administered regimens like Zusduri and Inlexzo.

* **[Biotech]** **[uniQure set to report 4-year Huntington’s disease gene therapy data](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/10/uniqure-huntingtons-gene-therapy-trial-readout/)** — *STAT*
  * Four-year follow-up data from the Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating AAV5 gene therapy candidate AMT-130 in Huntington’s disease are expected by late September.

* **[Biotech]** **[Roivant advances inhaled sGC activator mosliciguat following Phase 2 trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/10/roivant-biotech-dealmaking-mosliciguat-origins/)** — *STAT*
  * Soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) activator mosliciguat achieved positive efficacy endpoints in a mid-stage trial for pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD).

* **[Biotech]** **[Phase 1 trial of IV CD3×CD19 bispecific shows activity in systemic lupus erythematosus](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04572-7)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Intravenous administration of a CD3×CD19 T-cell engager was well tolerated and reduced disease activity scores in patients with active SLE.

* **[Biotech]** **[Subgroup analysis of Phase 2b trial confirms rademikibart response in Type 2 asthma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42717393/)** — *PubMed*
  * Exploratory analyses from a Phase 2b study demonstrated consistent efficacy of rademikibart across patient subgroups defined by Type 2 inflammatory biomarkers.

* **[Proof-of-concept Phase 1/2 study evaluates PP-01 for cannabis withdrawal](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42717263/)** — *PubMed*
  * An early clinical trial indicated that experimental agent PP-01 significantly mitigated withdrawal symptoms in individuals diagnosed with cannabis use disorder.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca reports positive Phase 3 results in COPD exacerbation reduction](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/09/astrazeneca-copd-win-fda-filling-key-jobs/)** — *STAT*
  * An experimental therapy met primary endpoints across two Phase 3 trials, significantly reducing moderate-to-severe exacerbations in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

* **[Biotech]** **[DFTX to present Phase 3 data in major depressive disorder and generalized anxiety disorder](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2098003925475492347)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Topline data from the pivotal Phase 3 Emerge trial (MDD) and Voyage trial (GAD) will be presented at an upcoming medical congress.

* **[Biotech]** **[Pooled analysis validates clinical meaningfulness of roluperidone in schizophrenia](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.07.26362403)** — *medRxiv*
  * Pooled 12-week data from two clinical trials showed roluperidone significantly improved negative symptoms compared to placebo using key benchmark anchors: 20% PANSS-NSFS improvement (38% vs 21%, p = 0.0008) and 1-point CGI-S improvement (41% vs 27%, p = 0.0077).

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA grants accelerated approval to Bayer’s Hyrnuo for HER2-mutated NSCLC](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-sevabertinib-locally-advanced-or-metastatic-non-squamous)** — *FDA*
  * Kinase inhibitor sevabertinib (Hyrnuo) received accelerated approval for adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC harboring HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain mutations.
  * The action expands the prior indication to include first-line patients without requiring previous systemic therapy [X / @JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2097714180119781820).

* **[Big Pharma]** **[China approves Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy for MASH](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097984851123073288)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Regulatory authorities in China approved semaglutide (Wegovy) as the country's first GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis.

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA places partial clinical hold on Biohaven’s BHV-7000](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097991434699690369)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * A partial clinical hold was issued for the potassium channel opener opakalim (BHV-7000) across its clinical program.

* **[FDA appoints permanent leadership for CDER and CBER](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-mikhail-davis-cber-cder-director-hhs/829886/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Michael Davis was named permanent Director of CDER, and Karim Mikhail was appointed Director of CBER.
  * The agency established a new executive position, naming Jared Seehafer as Deputy Commissioner for Technology and AI.

* **[FDA moves to remove GLP-1 receptor agonists from 503B bulk compounding list](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/human-drug-compounding/human-drug-compounding-policies-and-rules)** — *FDA*
  * The FDA issued a Federal Register notice proposing the exclusion of semaglutide, tirzepatide, and liraglutide from the 503B bulk drug substances list.

* **[Overview highlights expected Q4 2026 FDA PDUFA milestones](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00150-1)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*
  * Summary outlines major regulatory decisions and action dates anticipated from the FDA in the fourth quarter of 2026.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[Kura Oncology spins out Caspian Therapeutics with $50M for metabolic menin inhibitors](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/caspian-diabetes-kura-oncology-menin-inhibitors-lilly/829860/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Caspian Therapeutics launched with $50M co-led by Eli Lilly, BVF Partners, the T1D Fund, and Kura Oncology (which holds a ~50% stake) to advance lead menin inhibitor KO-7246 for pancreatic beta-cell regeneration in diabetes.

* **[Biotech]** **[Axogen to acquire BioCircuit Technologies for $200M](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097991189282586633)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  * Axogen entered an agreement to acquire BioCircuit Technologies for $200M in cash, funded by a concurrent $208M public offering priced at $42.50 per share.

* **[Biotech]** **[Gossamer Bio implements 1-for-80 reverse stock split](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097672043101638937)** — *BioStocks*
  * Gossamer Bio is executing a 1-for-80 reverse stock split.
  * As part of the capital restructuring, the company's authorized common stock will be reduced from 4 billion to 50 million shares.

* **[ARPA-H commits $62.7M to AI autonomous agents for heart failure care](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/09/arpa-h-advocate-program-autonomous-ai-bots-for-heart-failure/)** — *STAT*
  * Funding via the ADVOCATE program will support the development of FDA-authorized autonomous AI tools to guide clinical treatment decisions in heart failure.

* **[Industry report highlights radiopharmaceutical supply chain scale and M&A synergies](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2097692771033165942)** — *Andrew Pannu*
  * A report evaluating over 2,000 radiopharmaceutical programs emphasizes that M&A revenue synergies in the space are driven by specialized supply chain logistics.
  * Established radiopharma platforms leverage pre-existing infrastructure—such as isotope procurement, manufacturing redundancy, and nuclear medicine network access—to extract superior unit economics from acquired assets.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[UK commission issues guidelines for medical AI regulation](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/09/uk-unveils-recommendations-ai-regulation-medicine/)** — *STAT*
  * A regulatory commission released official recommendations to govern the integration, safety oversight, and validation of AI systems deployed in clinical medicine.

* **[Infant death confirmed in expanding Pennsylvania measles outbreak](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/09/coroner-details-infant-deaths-pennsylvania-measles-outbreak/)** — *STAT*
  * Local health officials confirmed that direct viral infection caused an infant death associated with a regional surge in measles cases.

* **[Telemedicine platform markets off-label GLP-1s for addiction](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/09/health-news-telemedicine-company-offers-glp-1s-for-addiction/)** — *STAT*
  * Direct-to-consumer digital health providers have begun prescribing GLP-1 receptor agonists off-label for substance use disorders despite limited prospective clinical validation.

**Worth watching:** uniQure's upcoming late-September 4-year trial readout for its AAV5 Huntington's disease gene therapy (AMT-130), alongside potential market ripple effects following FDA's proposed removal of GLP-1 receptor agonists from 503B compounding lists.
